Harmanpreet Kaur Tears Up During Live TV Interview

Indian cricketer Harmanpreet Kaur became emotional and fought back tears during a live television interview following her unbeaten 91 against Zimbabwe. The incident occurred during her first interaction after a captaincy transition. Kaur expressed a desire to "enjoy" the game.
